items.text:
This is a cheat code.

10 free GitHub repos turn Claude Code into your own trading terminal. A Bloomberg Terminal costs $31,980 a year.

Prices. Research agents. Backtests. Crypto.

01 TradingAgents → an analyst team, a trader and a risk desk debate a ticker before any call
http://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents

02 OpenBB → equities, ETFs, crypto, options and macro, with a ready connector for AI agents
http://github.com/OpenBB-finance/OpenBB

03 yfinance → free Yahoo Finance quotes in Python
http://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance

04 AI Hedge Fund → investor agents that paper trade and replay history
http://github.com/virattt/ai-hedge-fund

05 Vibe-Trading → type a question, get a report, a backtest and a paper portfolio
http://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading

06 Qlib → Microsoft's AI platform for quant investing
http://github.com/microsoft/qlib

07 vectorbt → runs thousands of strategy ideas at once
http://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt

08 Freqtrade → a crypto bot with a dry-run mode, controlled from Telegram
http://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade

09 CCXT → one API for 100+ crypto exchanges, with an official MCP server
http://github.com/ccxt/ccxt

10 NautilusTrader → a Rust engine where one strategy runs in simulation and live
http://github.com/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader

Data → analysis → simulation → fake-money trading.

#02, #05 and #09 connect to Claude over MCP. The rest are Python tools it installs and runs for you.

520,000+ GitHub stars between them, all free to use.

Which one would you point at the market first?

BREAKING: GTA 6 JUST CAME OUT. ELON MUSK HAS 43 DAYS LEFT TO KEEP HIS PROMISE.

In the video below, Musk calls it live on stream, then the boss of GTA's publisher takes a shot at him.

It was the Grok 4 launch in July 2025. Musk described AI building a whole game you could run on a PC, a console or a phone.

"I would expect the first really good AI video game to be next year," he said.

Three months later he turned it into a deadline, posting on X that xAI's game studio would release one before the end of 2026.

Strauss Zelnick runs Take-Two, which publishes GTA. At a Semafor summit in April, he aimed the AI jobs debate at Musk. The richest man on earth has unlimited money and people and works 20 hours a day, so if AI takes anyone's job, why not his?

Then Zelnick delivered the punchline.
"Maybe Elon Musk is indeed a simulation."

This month he told investors that hit games still come from people.

xAI hasn't announced a title or a release date.

Will Musk pull it off in 43 days, or is this just another Elon deadline?
